referenceName: At-home hospice support with a service compass and guided resources

source.name: Lap of Love Veterinary Hospice official website
source.sourceType: official direct veterinary-business website, captured in Playwright Chromium
source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance on 2026-09-29 covers retaining the paired desktop/mobile full-page captures, deriving a design prompt, and using these captures as internal pipeline-model visual references. No source-owner grant was supplied.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: This care-support site uses a narrow utility header and a softly tinted opening with a concise service identity, a large home setting photograph, and a location lookup. Six outlined shortcut tiles act as a service compass. A veterinarian profile section combines short biography text with a horizontal portrait selector, while a simple vertical service index gives the page an accessible information spine. Testimonial cards sit within a warm contrasting chapter; practical articles form a looser image mosaic. A second location finder and distinct support callout finish the conversion path before a dark, multi-column footer. The overall voice is measured and compassionate. Translate the calm decision architecture and separate pathways, not the source words, brand mark, pet photographs, people, endorsements, or any medical guidance.

heroGeometry.mode: soft two-field opening with service title and locator opposite an in-home photograph
heroGeometry.alignment: left editorial copy and right image
heroGeometry.viewport: service identity and find-care action are present before secondary information

navigationGeometry.mode: quiet utility bar with compact category links and discrete appointment controls
navigationGeometry.mobile: two-row utility and brand actions above stacked promise, finder, image, and shortcuts

typography.scale: moderate title, generous section headings, compact labels

palette.contrastIntent: low-stress surfaces with dark text and distinct accessible control boundaries

imageTreatment.crop: large welcoming hero portrait, small profile thumbnails, varied article crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: keep pet-family interaction gentle and legible; never imply a source person represents the generated practice

servicePresentation.pattern: icon-led service compass at the opening followed by a plain vertical service menu
servicePresentation.interaction: each item leads to a dedicated explanation or a clearly qualified contact route

ctaPlacement.primary: find the appropriate provider or service area
ctaPlacement.early: location finder appears directly below the opening promise

motion.primitive: portrait and testimonial carousels with visible next/previous controls
motion.library: native CSS or framework primitives; no source scripts
motion.reducedMotion: show a static, browsable set of profiles and testimonials

mobileRecomposition.strategy: place location and care-finder actions before stacked service, profile, testimonial, and resource chapters
rules: make the service compass a touch-friendly two-column or vertical set
keep long service labels fully visible
avoid an always-on chat tool obscuring content
provide non-carousel ways to reach profiles and stories

prohibitedPatterns: using source hospice or end-of-life copy as medical guidance
reusing brand symbols, photos, veterinarians, testimonials, phone number, or client stories
making clinical or emotional outcomes sound guaranteed
borrowing service coverage or availability without client confirmation

requiredSignatureElements.description: A compact set of distinct care routes appears near the opening as a service compass.
A verified provider or process profile uses a restrained editorial portrait and short readable context.
Practical education or preparation content is presented as a varied editorial resource group, not another uniform product grid.

acceptanceChecks: The page separates service routes from informational resources.
Any locator asks only for a real operating area and does not imply a storefront where none exists.
Medical statements and end-of-life language are only used when the client specifically offers and verifies that service.
Mobile keeps support actions reachable without obstructing the page.
Source identities, photos, testimonials, medical claims, contact details, and coverage are not copied.

review.notes: Official site returned HTTP 200 at both requested viewports. Full-page screenshots were recaptured after accepting its cookie prompt in the disposable browser page; no visible broken content images or JavaScript page errors were recorded. A blank embedded media rectangle is visible in both captures and is excluded as a source failure, not a signature.
